newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan buys 4,500 tonnes RBD palm oil.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys 4,500 tonnes RBD palm oil.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) has bought 4,500 tonnes of RBD palm oil at $512.90 per tonne FOB for shipment in the second half of November, dealers said on Thursday.

The TCP, which buys for the state-run Ghee Corp of Pakistan, invited and opened bids on Wednesday for two lots of 4,500 tonnes each for shipment in the first and second half of November, a dealer at Saulat Enterprises said.
The TCP scrapped bids for the first half and accepted one bid at $512.90 for shipment in the second half, the dealer said.
